decision.summary: A temporary offset is evident in U (and coherently in N) beginning at index 596, with a rapid descent over ~20 samples and a sustained low plateau through 619; the return phase is incomplete and ambiguous within allowed context [560,660], as U does not revert to pre-offset levels by index 620 and continues fluctuating without clear opposing edge. No confirmed full-cycle temporary interval; status is uncertain due to unobserved or incomplete return.

intervals.observation: U-component shows abrupt multi-sample descent from ~−5 to −15 MAD starting at index 596, sustained through 619; N declines modestly (~−3 MAD) over same span; E remains near zero with minor fluctuations. Return not observed by index 620 (last sample before opposing motion), and subsequent U values show only partial recovery (e.g., −14 at 621, −13 at 622), insufficient to confirm full reversal within allowed context.
